sloka: वन्दितव्याः च ते नित्यम् याः शेषा मम मातरः ।स्नेह प्रणय सम्भोगैः समा हि मम मातरः ॥२-२६-३२॥
transliteration: vanditavyāḥ ca te nityam yāḥ śeṣā mama mātaraḥ ।sneha praṇaya sambhogaiḥ samā hi mama mātaraḥ ॥2-26-32॥

translations.english: In terms of love, affection and service, the rest of my mothers are all equal. Therefore, you must pay them due respect regularly.
